# Default calendar belongs to the dialog window

For D332509 at revision 3d29fe1d078b26b2f91ee102bc82cfd2308867f1, the AI inspection reports that the create default comes from cal.view.getCompositeCalendar(window).defaultCalendar and that the composite calendar is cached on the supplied window. In comments describing this default, “the window that contains the dialog” clarifies the ambiguous term “host,” which does not mean a server here. This wording change was proposed but not accepted or applied in the supplied record; it establishes no broader terminology rule.

Scope: Calendar event default selection.

## Evidence

[Lesson record](../records/1a961af20fc52b0a69f9f874f93257f2b9b5fa8d33808b5d07c7fd81d7ba20c6.json).
